informational: xtask so::tests::a_product_build_leaves_no_earlier_product_for_the_manifest_lint failed in gate3 (it passed in gate2): the gate runs it beside the products build, and the test lists target/niji while the build is still writing it (ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, getconf and getent were not there yet), so the lint it runs finds products missing; the test gives no hint of the order. Not touched by this story (xtask/src/so.rs unchanged); alone on the finished products it passes (job stale). Recommend: the test waits for the build or the gate runs it after the products step
